quote: from each milling I would get between 11-17 pigment
notes: Firsthand September 2024 observation of a repeated 11–17 Luredrop Pigment per completed milling operation. The post does not report herb rank, pigment rank, number of mills, per-output hit count, 0-bin, histogram, exact stacks by operation, character skill/spec, patch/build, or Resourcefulness and refunds; keep those unknown. The 10-herb batch is corroborated by earlier TWW recipe records, not stated in this post. Historical range only, not a current-patch measured probability. This Saisino observation is distinct from the Sep 16 2024 average by another author (reddit-1fi0n6e). Do not assign any rank-specific item ID.
